author: PiersMorgan
text:
WATCH: Piers Morgan calls for Charles Spencer’s book to be withdrawn from sale.
Says he’ll press ahead with legal action.
Says Spencer’s claim Morgan was surly on the phone that week was a wrong characterisation - and questions therefore if Earl Spencer got it wrong about the Prince Charles phone call that same week in 1997 👇
